bio: Awarded AA Rosettes for culinary excellence, Mottram Hall prides itself on an outstanding range of dining options. With a range of dishes on offer, you’re sure to find something to tantalise your taste buds. You can enjoy a relaxing moment with friends and family, tucking into light bites or Afternoon Tea and on warmer days, sip on a refreshing drink on the terrace.  A warm and cosy setting, surrounded by sweeping Cheshire countryside, Mottram Hall’s Champagne Bar is the ideal place to enjoy a glass of your favourite tipple and Afternoon Tea. Dressed in plush velvet and calming hues, it’s the perfect place to celebrate with friends and family.  Whether you are celebrating a special occasion, or just fancy an indulgent treat, we’ll spoil you with a homemade selection of freshly cut finger sandwiches and warm scones smothered in jam and clotted cream. Plus, you’ll be able to choose from our exceptional range of speciality leaf teas or coffees.
